get.description:
Return public card fields for active agents, optionally scoped to a saved team.

Cards omit endpoint URLs, interfaces, and security data; clients reach an
agent through Hybro by ``agent_id``.

Only public agents and the caller's own private agents are visible. Saved
groups must belong to the caller. No network scan or card refresh is performed.
`all_agents` selects all visible agents; `room_team` is not supported.

List the caller's saved groups (subnets) with active visible member counts.

Built-in selections such as `all_agents` and `room_team` are not included.

Rank visible active agents for a capability query, optionally in a group.

Results are compact consumer views with the caller's groups for each agent.
Ranking is lexical over Card names, descriptions, skills, and tags; an
empty list means no agent matched the query terms.
Return a visible agent's consumer profile without transport or security data.

post.description:
Send one A2A message to a registered active agent without creating a room.

`result` preserves the remote A2A Message or Task, including nonterminal and
failed task states. The call waits at most 600 seconds. A timeout does not
cancel remote work; requests are not automatically resent. Request IDs
provide correlation, not idempotency. Targets must be public or caller-owned;
saved groups must belong to the caller. Request bodies are capped at 6 MiB,
with at most four admitted sends per backend worker and no waiting queue.

Cancel an ongoing message processing workflow.

This marks the message as cancelled, which will be detected at the next
checkpoint in the workflow, causing it to stop gracefully.

Args:
    message_id: The ID of the message to cancel
    user: Authenticated user

Returns:
    dict: Success status and message

Send one text message to one agent, opening a session without `session_id`.

Returns a receipt as soon as Hybro has the message: `status` is `created`
when this message opened the session, `accepted` for a later message, or
`busy` when it was not recorded because an earlier message is still
active. The receipt carries the session's `created_at` and `updated_at`.
The agents' responses come from `GET /sessions/{session_id}`. Retrying
with the same `client_request_id` returns the same receipt.

post.description:
Send message to room - PROTECTED (requires room ownership)

This endpoint:
1. Creates the user message and generates agent messages
2. Persists a changed request mode as the room's next-message default
3. Automatically queues background processing of agent messages

The mode write completes before a successful acknowledgement is returned.
The frontend no longer needs to call processRoomUserMessage separately.
Processing happens atomically to prevent orphaned messages on page refresh.
Atomically submit every required answer for one interaction.

get.description:
create SSE message stream for specified room

The stream is snapshot-driven (Room Stream Snapshot plan §4): the
``connected`` handshake carries the room's latest contiguous ``room_seq``
and a ``snapshot`` frame follows as the first frame. ``?snapshot=1``
forces a fresh fold from the authoritative room event log (gap recovery).
Without a bound snapshot service, or when the snapshot build fails, the
stream continues delta-only with an unchanged envelope.

Args:
    conversation_id: room ID
    user: Authenticated user (from header or query param token)

Returns:
    StreamingResponse: SSE stream response

get SSE connection status for specified room

Args:
    conversation_id: room ID
    user: Authenticated user (from header or query param token)

Returns:
    dict: room connection status information

Replay persisted public room events (Room Stream Snapshot plan §5).

This is a fallback read path, not a delivery channel: the primary
live-recovery path remains re-requesting a snapshot over the stream.
Cold hydration (no ``after`` yet) is ``after=0``. Auth is identical to
the SSE stream route.
